description_en: Creates an edge application service to host edge services on containers (virtual devices), bare metal instances, or virtual machines
description_zh: 调用CreateApplication创建一个边缘应用服务，实现容器（虚拟设备）、裸金属或虚机的边缘服务托管
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-application --template '{\"appMetaData\":{        \"appName\":\"nginx\",        \"clusterName\":\"poc\",        \"appType\":\"Common\",        \"description\":\" test service\"    },    \"resourceAttribute\":{        \"resourceType\":\"\",        \"instanceSpec\":\"ens.sn1.tiny\",        \"systemDiskSize\":20,        \"dataDiskSize\":0,        \"bandwithOut\":10,        \"areaLevel\":\"National\",        \"netSecurityStrategy\":null,        \"initConfig\":null    },    \"resourceSelector\":[        {            \"count\":1        }    ],    \"workload\":[        {            \"podCount\":1,            \"serviceConfig\":null,            \"name\":\"nginx\",            \"podSpec\":{                \"containers\":[                    {                        \"name\":\"android\",                        \"image\":\"edge-registry.alicdn.com/test/nginx\"                    }                ]            },            \"count\":1        }    ]}' --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateApplication

parameters.help_en:
The edge application template in JSON format. It contains the following information:

Basic information such as the application name.
Resource specifications and network security configurations.
Business configurations.
Resource requirements
parameters.help_zh:
边缘应用模版，Json格式的字符串，包含：

应用名等基本信息；
资源规格、网络安全配置等信息；
业务配置
资源需求量
parameters.name: template

parameters.help_en: The timeout period for asynchronous processing. Unit: seconds. Default value: 1800
parameters.help_zh: 异步处理的超时时间。单位秒，默认1800
parameters.name: timeout

AppId.description_en: The application ID generated upon successful creation. It is the unique identifier of the edge application service
AppId.description_zh: 创建成功生成的应用ID，是用户边缘应用服务的唯一标识
